parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description. The description must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), and spaces. The description can also contain Chinese characters.

parameters.name: DestinationType
parameters.description:
The destination type. Valid values:
- **Connector**: connector.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name can also contain Chinese characters.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: The policy priority. A value of 1 indicates the highest priority. Valid values: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The policy status. Valid values:
- **Enabled**: enabled.
- **Disabled**: disabled.
